name: arya-punch
notes: Audition variant of the user-approved custom-2, for stock pads. Stronger kick and bass-line emphasis: 2 dB more at 100 Hz relative to the midrange, with almost unchanged deep sub-bass and the same midrange/treble filters. Raw device Q; the 100 Hz Q is adjusted to retain approximately the baseline bandwidth. All five arya audition presets use -11.5 dB preamp, 1.5 dB below custom-2; equal preamp is not perceptual loudness matching. Modeled headroom only; not acoustically verified or auditioned. Start quietly.
